newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar rises marginally in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar rises marginally in moderate trade.

text.p: Sugar prices rose marginally in moderate trade on Wednesday, dealers said.
Ready sugar S-30 gained five rupees to 1,430/1,455 rupees per quintal (100 kg) and M-30 made a similar gain to 1,465/1,500 rupees per quintal.
In mill delivery, S-30 was quoted 15 rupees higher at 1,375/1,395 rupees per quintal and M-30 was offered five rupees higher at 1,390/1,420 rupees per quintal.
Dealers said the market was awaiting the free sale sugar quota for the quarter July-September.
"We are a bit worried it might be less than the previous quarter's quota," said a dealer. The government had released 2.17 million tonnes for the April-June quarter.
